title: Channel action on behalf of a person
description: Who pressed the button or gave the command and from which chat. This is not an operation body: the channel passes these values in the headers Botaru-On-Behalf and Botaru-Chat (spec/bindings/http/README.md). The core accepts them only from the process of the channel through whose driver the person came: the identity kind matches the channel driver, the identity belongs to an active human principal of the channel's tenant with strong identity, for a card the chat is the one where this channel delivered it, and for a P2 command the chat is this person's direct chat with this channel (APR-4, IDN-3, IDN-7, PRM-15). The schema sets the form of the header values.

message.description: Header Botaru-Message: the external id of the card message on which the button was pressed; the core checks it against the external_id of the card delivery to this chat. A text command has no such field.
